text.content:
The netrunner who broke the NET.

Role: Netrunner (dead)
Status: Died in 2020
Known for: The DataKrash and the RABIDs

The greatest netrunner of the Old NET: a paranoid genius who believed information should be free and hated the corps. He died in 2020. Two years later his last joke went off: the DataKrash, hidden inside the NET's standard algorithms, scrambled corporate data and loosed his self-replicating RABIDs, which tore the Old NET apart. They still run behind the Blackwall.

His followers outlived him. The man behind the 2047 broadcast hijack, the Moon rock and the Static Night bombing was a Bartmoss cultist, one of the believers who think the Old NET should be set free. The old Trauma Team tower site in Watson is called Bartmoss's Thumb.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.12; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 06
